messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to formalize the SLO split and track owners/timelines here.

aj-ops: Agreed. prefer a plan that can be canaried; no global knob flips please. :+1:

sam: Proposal sketch: split SLOs into control-plane (short-tail) and inference-lane (throughput-aware). control-plane: p95 < 1s, rolling 5m window, error budget on control-plane only. inference-lane: window 1h, target 99.5% latency < 300ms, with documented maintenance fallback to 99.0%.

linh: Split makes sense. suggest we keep a conservative burn-rate alert at 10%/h for the control-plane so we detect fast regressions.

maria: Owners: @aj-ops owns control-plane SLO config + alert tuning. @sam owns inference-lane SLO spec and rollout plan. @ryan owns dashboard updates and annotations. @linh owns cross-region burst detector prototype.

aj-ops: Ill open a config PR with feature flags for canary. plan: staged rollout to 5% traffic in staging, 1% in prod, then 10% after 48h. ETA initial PR by EOW.

ryan: Dashboard plan: 1) tile comparing old vs new P95 windows, 2) error-budget-burn slope chart, 3) incident annotations layer. will add readme for PGs on interpretation. ETA 48h.

oncall-bot: Incident #2026-03-22-77 annotated: root cause identified as KV-cache thrash at 03:12 UTC.

sam: For rollout math, suggested spec:
```
# inference SLO
window = 1h
target = 99.5% (latency < 300ms)
fallback_target = 99.0% (maintenance windows)
measurement = histogram-based p99/p95 and count of requests over threshold
```
We enforce automated rollback if burn-rate > 50% in 30m.

linh: Ill prototype a cron job that scans for correlated burst signatures across regions (same pattern we saw in the last three incidents). assign to me; ETA 10 days.

maria: Action tracker (short):
- aj-ops: control-plane SLO config + canary flags + PR (ETA: 3 business days)
- sam: inference-lane SLO spec + rollback rules + test harness (ETA: 5 business days)
- ryan: dashboard tiles, annotations layer, readme (ETA: 2 business days)
- linh: cross-region burst detector prototype (ETA: 10 days)

aj-ops: Will post link to PR here once opened. includes staged canary and metric guards.

ryan: Ill also add a short explainer on the dashboard about how to read "error budget slope" vs "instantaneous latency".

maria: Request: add a lightweight CI test in the postmortem repo that reproduces a KV-cache thrash at low QPS so SLOs can be validated against regressions. assigning to @sam.

sam: Will add a small load harness in CI and wire events to the dashboard annotations.

oncall-bot: Reminder: SLO review sync in 7 days — update the tracker before meeting.

maria: Thanks everyone — updating the postmortem with owners & dates now. if anything slips please ping here. :white_check_mark:
